correctness.rationale: Each cell is a triple of disjoint nonempty color blocks; a nonidentity prime target-color rotation would require all blocks invariant under a transitive p-cycle, an impossibility. Thus the action on geometric points is free. Babson–Kozlov supply the unquotiented X≃∨^(2^p−3)S^(p−3), so it is simply connected. The Cartan–Leray homology spectral sequence has rows zero and d=p−3; in degrees 0<i<d, its only contributors are H_i(C_p;Z), and cellular dimension d makes top H_d free. Euler divided by p fixes top rank (2^p−p−2)/p. The Serre/Borel mod-p multiplicative classifying map is an isomorphism for totals <d, so v u^((d−2)/2) is nonzero in degree d−1, while the single degree-one generator v has v²=0 and total dimension bounds all longer products. Bockstein β(v)=u only claimed when 2<d (p≥7). Independent cell-orbit counts are p=5 (12,36,30) χ=6 top rank5, p=7 (30,180,450,540,258) χ=18 top rank17; these finite counts do not prove all primes.
